destinations.description: Open a main Folio screen: Home, Library, Downloads or Server settings.
destinations.verification: The requested tab is selected and its content is visible. Server opens settings only; it does not connect or change credentials.

destinations.description: Search the current Folio library by book title or author. Does not search Free books, download, open a book or start playback.

query.description: Title or author text, for example Alice.

destinations.verification: The library search shows the requested query and matching titles, or an explicit no-matches message.
